name: injury-day
description: Part B test day: a bleeding cut at the smithy, a fall in the old mine, an infection brewing in a neglected burn, and a serious wound with the healer close by. Reseed first and reuse the seed to replay it.

actions.cause: a slipped chisel at the forge
actions.comment: a venous gash on the smith: a bandage case
a burn nobody dresses: infection later
a broken shin: splint, set, a crutch

actions.text: Someone shouts that a man has been badly cut near the well. You grab what you need.

actions.comment: maybe the femoral artery: a tourniquet case
